releases.notes:
Builds for Minecraft 26.3 and 26.2.

Pick the jar that matches your Minecraft version. SHA-256 sums are in SHA256SUMS.txt. The manifest-*.json files are what the CxVisuals cloud reads to update installs automatically.

Changes
- Documented effects through glass and water and death effects under shader packs
- Showed entity effects and death effects through tinted glass and water by testing against depth from before translucent terrain
- Made the seed forecast optional and off by default
- Documented the seed forecast
- Added a seed forecast that draws unexplored areas from the world seed in all dimensions
- Kept the real ground under thin sky builds, grew open-edge skirts toward the ground and sped up the floor search
- Documented the automatic release pull to the cloud
- Published per-version client manifests with every release so the cloud can pull builds from GitHub
- Restored full water flows in the 3D map and drew the steps between water columns - Map 3D
- Stopped region disk reads from blocking the render thread through the shared decode lock
- Capped water side walls in the 3D map so floating water shows as a thin sheet - Map 3D
- Documented the map warm-up and loading pattern
- Added background map warm-up after joining and a pulsing dot pattern on tiles still loading
- Documented waypoint icons, the clean 3D map edge, mod channels on the main menu and the HUD tray
- Added waypoint icons with name and surroundings suggestions and an eased label expand
- Cut map hitches from region eviction churn, covered-set rebuilds and atlas overcommit
- Faded deep walls and the underground layer into the cloud sea under the 3D map - Map 3D
- Fixed menu sliders resizing and shifting while being dragged
- Added channels for Mod Menu and other mod buttons on the custom main menu
- Fixed clicks passing through the element tray to the bar and a duplicate Info label
- Cleaned the 3D map bottom edge with a fading skirt and no cave floors on borders - Map 3D
- Fixed text boxes not receiving typing on 26.3 by starting SDL text input on our screens
- Repaired saved unbound keys from options on startup to stop the world join crash
- Made every push to main publish the GitHub release for the current version
- Fixed crash on world join from unbound keys using -1 instead of the 26.3 unknown key
- Fixed region labels jumping during zoom with stable anchors and fades
- Cut large map hitches with compact region thumbnails and timed uploads
- Fixed far zoom cut-off and sped up tile baking and 3D loading
- Reworked region labels to one chip per region with softer borders
- Added GitHub build and tag release workflows
- Documented the new modules and the privacy notice
- Added 26.2 and 26.3 builds from one source tree with per-version update manifests
- Fixed shader sources, mixins and mouse buttons for 26.3
- Ported the client to the 26.3 render, input and auth APIs
- Merged Friends, Accounts, Waypoints, Download, Nametags, Deaths and Swing Trails into host modules
- Added DonutSMP region overlay, Explore page, chunk previews, faster live sharing and unlimited zoom out
- Added shared live maps with friends, per-friend location and faster map saving
- Added live nearest-first block search and gear icons on player cards
- Added block search, player heads and cards, 3D map setting and lighter chunk loading
- Fixed fog hiding explored areas on the map
- Fixed block sides, floating platforms, water under overhangs and slow loading
- Added overhangs, cloud sea and teleport glide, fixed Nether shutdown
- Added 3D map view and mob head icons
- Fixed water colour, clipping and cloud pops, added mobs and 3D blocks
- Added map, minimap and world download modules
- Added place and break styles and fixed beds, torches and block entities
- Added restyling for text display holograms
- Fixed trails cutting off on flip swings and their hard edges
- Added swing trails with five styles for first and third person
- Fixed entity effects staying visible behind walls

...
